scientific_intent.scientific_operator: Pointwise static cast among BF16/FP16/FP32/I32/I8/U8 (30 directed type pairs; no BF16 destination)
scientific_intent.numerical_method: IEEE nearest-even floating conversions and truncating in-range float-to-int; fixed-width integer narrowing modulo on measured toolchain
scientific_intent.community_use: Representation fidelity primitive relevant to numerical pipelines; no specific physical or statistical simulation
scientific_intent.accuracy_requirements: Every destination raw bit against independent IEEE/integer oracle, signed zeros/rounding ties/subnormal and integer extrema, source preservation and exact guards
limitations: Native CLI reads uninitialized source allocations; named fixtures initialize all values
All floating-to-integer inputs finite and in representable range, exceptional/overflow float-cast semantics unmeasured
Signed integer narrowing is measured implementation policy, not universal C++ language guarantee
Small17/257sizes are launch dominated, not a large array bandwidth result
